method: Every reachable source commit reviewed once, weight=1; one primary category per nonmerge commit, merges counted separately. Dates, churn, author and recency do not alter weight. Related commits and scoped backports are explained as grouped work, not repeated features. PR association uses merge-first-parent..merge-second-parent reachability, not title guessing.
